verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no official AI assistant inside Babylon.js, the Playground, the Inspector or the Node Material Editor that generates scripts, answers API questions or scaffolds scenes. Published llms.txt files only make the docs easier for outside LLMs to read. That is adjacent documentation support, not an in-engine assistant, and the probe notes there is no official MCP server either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official AI assistant inside the engine helps with engine tasks — generating scripts, answering API questions, scaffolding scenes or assets
